abilities.name: Armor Up
abilities.description: Garrosh gains 1 Armor for every 2% of maximum Health missing.

fields.notes: Only updates every 187.5ms (3 server ticks). Armor Up stacks with other sources of Armor.

abilities.name: Groundbreaker
abilities.description: Deal 81 damage to enemies in an area. Heroes hit on the outer edge are Stunned for 0.5 seconds and then Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Slow, Stun

abilities.name: Bloodthirst
abilities.description: Deal 156 damage to an enemy and heal for 10% of Garrosh's missing Health. Healing is increased by 100% against Heroes.

fields.notes: Healing bonus to Heroes directly increases the base healing amount, causing the given percentage to stack multiplicatively with healing modifiers.

abilities.name: Wrecking Ball
abilities.description: Throw a nearby enemy Hero, Minion, or Mercenary to the target location, dealing 91 damage to enemies near the impact and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

fields.props: Clamping Impact - Area of Effect, Slow Throw - Displacement, Daze, Stun
fields.notes: Automatically selects the enemy closest to Garrosh to be thrown, indicated by a red marker above the unit. Does not prioritize Heroes. Enemy Structures and Summons (that are not Heroic Pets) and Monsters can be damaged, but not thrown. The thrown enemy is briefly Stunned, interrupting channeled abilities, and then Dazed for the remainder of the flight. The thrown enemy also receives the impact effects upon landing.

abilities.name: Warlord's Challenge
abilities.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: The effect ends immediately if Garrosh dies. Taunt counts as a Silence.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.description: Deal 50 damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second. Stores up to 3 charges.; 8 / 1.0

fields.notes: Damage bonus to Heroes stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Decimate 's damage.

abilities.name: Into the Fray
abilities.description: Activate to throw a nearby ally and grant them 20 Armor for 3 seconds. Deals 91 damage to nearby enemies upon impact and Slows them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. While in flight, allied Heroes are Unstoppable.

fields.type: Spell damage, Crowd control (impact) / Crowd control, Defensive damage modifier, Status effect
fields.props: Clamping Impact - Area of Effect, Slow Throw - Armor, Displacement, Daze, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Automatically selects the ally closest to Garrosh to be thrown, indicated by a blue marker above the unit. Does not prioritize Heroes. The thrown ally is Dazed during the flight, interrupting stationary channeled abilities. Into the Fray cannot target Unstoppable or Invulnerable allies, Structures or Summons that are not Heroic Pets. Into the Fray does not benefit from any Talents affecting Wrecking Ball.

talents.name: Warbreaker
talents.description: Quest Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker. After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker deals an additional 165 damage over 3 seconds to Heroes. Reward After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Actually gives Quest stacks any time it hits a Hero, even if the Hero is Unstoppable (including but not limited to Deathwing and Vehicles).

_raw_fields: Quest Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker. After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker deals an additional 165 damage over 3 seconds to Heroes. Reward After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

talents.name: Unrivaled Strength
talents.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 120%.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Wrecking Ball 's damage.

_raw_fields: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 120%.

talents.name: Body Check
talents.description: Cooldown 15 Active Activate to deal 111 damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

fields.type: Spell damage, Crowd control / Healing received modifier
fields.notes: Healing reduction stacks additively with other healing received modifiers affecting the target.

talents.name: In For the Kill
talents.description: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 70%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

fields.notes: Cooldown is reset if the target enemy is killed within 0.5 seconds of being affected by Bloodthirst.

_raw_fields: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 70%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

talents.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

fields.type: Healing dealt modifier, Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Spell Power debuff from Oppressor stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers affecting the target Hero.
